narrative.summary: The League of Arab States has published the Arab Charter on the Ethics of Artificial Intelligence (July 2025), a guiding text prepared by the Arab AI working team under the Council of Arab Ministers of Communications and Information. The Council has also worked on a unified Arab strategic vision for AI and in January 2026 set up a permanent Arab committee for AI and emerging technologies, which is developing an Arab guiding framework for AI governance.

instruments.summary: Regional ethics charter for AI in the Arab region, prepared by the Arab AI Working Team at the mandate of the Council of Arab Ministers of Communications and Information, with a foreword by the League's Secretary-General. It covers AI systems across their lifecycle and addresses governments, the private sector, academia and civil society. It sets six pillars with guiding principles — Arab identity and belonging, ethical innovation, responsible use (safety, privacy, transparency, fairness, accountability, protection of vulnerable groups), agile governance, Arab integration, and sustainability — and recommends stakeholder roles and implementation and follow-up mechanisms.
instruments.current_status: Published in Arabic, dated July 2025, by the Arab AI Working Team of the League of Arab States; it describes itself as a guiding reference document that does not replace national policies or laws.
instruments.evidence_reference: PDF (59 pp.) read via WebFetch; text layer has OCR errors. Cover: 'فريق العمل العربي للذكاء الاصطناعي - جامعة الدول العربية', 'يوليو / تموز 2025'; title page 'الميثاق العربي لأخلاقيات الذكاء الاصطناعي - 2025'. No English version. Hosted on the site of the Arab ICT Organization (AICTO, a League specialised organisation) under Publications > Studies, because las.int refuses automated fetching; the file is the League's document itself. Background cites ESC resolution 2444 (9 May 2024) and a meeting at the League Secretariat 22–24 April 2024 on unethical uses of AI; Palestine submitted an initial proposal. Adoption: League SG Aboul Gheit is quoted (Al-Dostor, Aug 2025) saying the Council's Executive Office adopted the charter in July 2025; QNA and Maspero (22 Jan 2026) report that the 29th session of the Council of Arab Ministers of Communications and Information (Cairo, 22 Jan 2026) adopted 'ميثاق الأخلاقيات العربي للذكاء الاصطناعي'. Not confirmed from a League decision text, so lifecycle kept 'published'; upgrade to 'adopted' (22 Jan 2026, Council resolution) once las.int or the Council's decision record can be read. | Independent check 2026-10-21: Title, July 2025, Arab AI Working Team / Council of Arab Ministers of Communications and Information, foreword by the Secretary-General and six pillars confirmed. Host aicto.org is the Arab ICT Organization (an LAS specialised body).; Text describes itself as a guiding reference that does not replace national policies or laws, but does not state it is 'not legally binding'.

leads.title: الرؤية الاستراتيجية العربية الموحدة للذكاء الاصطناعي (Unified Arab Strategic Vision for Artificial Intelligence / 'Arab AI Strategy')
leads.note: League document (General Secretariat, Economic Sector, ICT Development Department; Technical Secretariat of the Council of Arab Ministers of Communications and Information) prepared under Council decision ق 573 - د.ع 23 (Riyadh, 18 Dec 2019). The PDF prints no date and its running header reads 'مقترح' (proposal). The League SG is quoted in the press saying the Council adopted the Arab AI strategy in January 2024; Egypt's minister dates it to early 2025. Record once a printed date or adoption decision is confirmed.
